title: Docs drift: README omits the health strip and the 4.2.0 CLI-first change; multi-account-cli.md is silent on token renewal, write-back and live-session rules; README:156 and docs/multi-account-cli.md:115 overclaim tmux propagation
first_slice: Update README and docs/multi-account-cli.md to match 4.3.3 behaviour

title: Auto-switch never re-arms once every profile was capped: it marks the capped profile, logs 'All profiles at 100% or unavailable', and retries only when that same profile drops below 100%, so an opted-in user stays stranded when another account comes back
first_slice: Re-run the auto-switch search on any eligible profile regaining room while the active one is capped

title: Auto-switch and Claude alerts watch only the 5-hour session window: a weekly limit at 100% never triggers a switch and never warns, although weeklyWarning/weeklyCritical alert types and their nine-locale strings exist and nothing sends them
first_slice: Decide whether the session-only policy is deliberate; if not, admit Claude weekly windows to alerts and to the auto-switch trigger

title: Link Account symlinks every top-level entry of ~/.claude except two files, so every linked account shares one projects/ (conversations and auto memory) and sessions/ pool, Team seats included, while the dialog says only settings are shared
first_slice: At minimum disclose it in the link dialog and docs; the deliberate per-account setting is Idea 2 (i-20261025-02)

title: Make Active reports success when the terminal pointer write failed: a thrown switchToAccount is logged 'non-fatal', the profile is still marked active and the button disappears; the auto-switch banner also fires when the request was dropped as 'already in progress'
first_slice: Make activateProfile return an outcome and show failure; the receipt-on-every-switch is Idea 8 (i-20261025-08)

title: The release pipeline never launches the built app: spctl and Gatekeeper checks pass a bundle that cannot start, which is how 3.3.0 shipped unlaunchable; the clean-account launch is a manual step after publishing
first_slice: Add a release gate that launches the notarized, stapled app from the DMG on a clean account and fails unless the process is still alive after N seconds

title: The live-process detector counts Claude Desktop's bundled Claude Code and headless `claude -p` workers as live sessions on the default account (any path containing /claude-code/, no CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR), so renewal can be refused and an account reported 'asleep' when no terminal session exists
first_slice: Exclude the Desktop bundle path and label print-mode runs before treating a match as a live session

title: Codex accounts have no place in the Health strip although their usage is already read (docs/menu-bar.md states 'Codex accounts keep their own items'; data present, screen missing — bug loop to decide whether design or defect)
first_slice: Draw Codex profiles as bars in the strip (first/second window), grouped after the Claude bars

title: Automatic overflow measures the menu-bar-owning screen with no notch handling, so on a notched MacBook the free-width probe may count the dead area under the notch and let an item sit behind it (unconfirmed)
first_slice: Subtract the notch's auxiliary-area gap from the probe's free width on built-in notched displays

title: The popover hotkey anchors only to a status item button and silently returns when there is none, so under a menu bar manager that hid the item (strip at x≈-4495 under Thaw) or with the strip layout it can open off-screen or do nothing
evidence: Claude Usage/MenuBar/MenuBarManager.swift:1679 (togglePopover guard let button … return)
first_slice: Fall back to a centred, non-anchored presentation when no visible status button exists

title: MCP sync reads and rewrites the whole .claude.json (pretty-printed, keys sorted) on every switch while a live claude session rewrites the same file, so a sync during a session can lose that session's update and reformats the user's file
first_slice: Skip the write when the account has a live claude process (the detector exists), or patch only the mcpServers key

title: The MCP union-merge keeps the first-seen definition per server name (home first) and ignores a differing duplicate silently, so a server edited in one account stays stale in every other account with no notice
first_slice: Report 'defined differently in N accounts' in the sync result instead of silently keeping the first

title: The Console cost source classifier tags any API key whose name contains 'cli' as a CLI key, so a key named 'client-prod' shows the terminal icon
first_slice: Match whole words / known Claude Code key name patterns, not a substring

title: A Claude profile pins its organization the first time it is read and never re-fetches the organization list, so a user who changes organization on the same login keeps reading the old one indefinitely
first_slice: Re-check the organization list on a periodic refresh or on each credential fingerprint change and surface a 'new organization available' line

title: Opus warning/critical alert types are declared with strings in all nine locales but nothing sends them (sibling of bc-20261025-03's dead weekly alerts); Sonnet and Fable have no alert at all
first_slice: Wire the model-cap alerts into the same policy that sends session alerts, under the weekly-alert fix
